fact: On 2 July 2024 the Government of Ghana, the EU and Smart Africa completed a two-day national validation workshop on the draft National Data Strategy, reviewing the draft and its implementation roadmap; the source describes it as a draft and reports no approval or launch.

fact: The Data Protection Commission led a 27-28 June 2024 validation workshop with stakeholders to finalise Ghana's National Data Strategy, reviewing the draft by the national taskforce.
